GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced keenly @ rear 3 Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & chasing Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. pressured 8W @ 300m & ground home steadily in last 200m. # Slow out/fair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down last 10 Lengths 800m 3 Wide 9th 8 Lengths home turn Four Wide 6th Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # back/wide/honest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Restrained Settled Down 11th Outside 8 Lengths Clear All The Way , let stride Five Wide Turning for home 7th x 200m but now flat , couldn't finish off - # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1000m steadied to avoid heels. Raced three wide with cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & held up 3 Wide @ 500m. Held up Four Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & hit top @ 100m. Hit line hard & grabbed leader on line. # Came from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Travelled keenly in the early and middle stages. Held up for clear running rounding the home turn until near the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length & Settled Down Mid Field 5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, railed up into a pocket rounding turn then shifted 2-3 Wide off heels after Straightening Up , Made Some Ground to the line. [Stewards: Over-raced early/middle stages.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down last 9 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 10 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground 1-2 off fence in straight. [Stewards: Over-raced early/middle stages.] # never a real threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 11 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 10 Lengths rail turning, Hooked Out to centre of track and Made Ground in Straight # slowly away

2 Lengths slow away. Recovered & raced Worse than midfield on inside (5L from lead) early . Stayed same until niggled to improve on inside @ 500m. Pushed along Two Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & only held ground Five Wide in straight. # Even effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding rider stated that his mount began awkwardly, losing ground (2L), and improved to settle in a midfield position. Rider added that his mount raced keenly in the early stages. Rider stated his mount failed to let down strongly in the straight and raced like a tired horse. Trainer agreed and advised he would freshen the gelding up and drop it back in distance at its next race start. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped out went back Soon After settled down second last 10 Lengths (1000m), peeled to the Outside top of the Straight trying to make Ground , made a little # back/closest late
Jumped Ok eased back 6-7l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well making good ground but no threat late # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier, was directed behind runners during the early stages.
